wire_mutation_locator.procedure: Require structural decodeOK; begin semantic-metadata section offset. Decode interface count and skip each interface identity/key/slot signature IDs with test_take_uvar. Require nonzero conformance count; skip first conformance ID/key plus three uvar fields; require nonzero slot count; return actual first slot byte cursor. wire_mutation_locator.boundary: This is deliberate semantic corruption to another in-range actual function. No current wire offset, table serialization or function-ID assignment is assumed. Current public packet semantic rejection must remain distinguishable from structural/identity rejection; Root must supply an equivalent current representation mutation.

negative_expectation_policy: Two semantic negatives are validated twice each: exact SEMANTIC_REJECTED/expected diagnostic/NULL product, repeated status and entire XrProgramDiagnostic memcmp equality including location fields. Bad-slot graph is exact producer BUILD_INVALID_INPUT with no semantic or runtime validation. Do not collapse these three original boundaries into any-nonzero/error success.
